maddeler.e:
استكبرا (form X)
# اِسْتَكْبَرَا (istakbarā) /is.tak.ba.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَكْبَرَ (istakbara)
# اُسْتُكْبِرَا (ustukbirā) /us.tuk.bi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَكْبَرَ (istakbara)
# اِسْتَكْبِرَا (istakbirā) /is.tak.bi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَكْبَرَ (istakbara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
